note: Engine POST /v1/percentiles fixtures. engine/tests/test_percentile_fixtures.py reads them with the engine models and docs/api/engine.yaml; the Spring client tests (MVP-18 PR B) read the same files. Valid entries must pass the engine.yaml schema and the engine model. Invalid entries must fail the engine model; the response fixture that breaks `below + equal <= n` is valid against the schema (a JSON schema cannot express it), so a client rejects it by its own check.
